```{r setup, include=FALSE}
#### Setup
# Load packages
library(blackmarbler)
library(geodata)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyterra)
library(lubridate)
library(gridExtra)
library(purrr)

#### Define NASA bearer token
bearer <- get_nasa_token(
    username = Sys.getenv("NASA_USERNAME"),
    password = Sys.getenv("NASA_PASSWORD")
)

### ROI
# Define region of interest (roi). The roi must be (1) an sf polygon and (2)
# in the WGS84 (epsg:4326) coordinate reference system. 
roi_sf <- gadm(country = "UGA", level=1, path = tempdir()) 
```

## Usage and Data Download

See <https://worldbank.github.io/blackmarbler/#usage>

```{r}
# Force BlackMarbler to use wget for downloading (needed on Windows)
Sys.setenv(LAADS_DOWNLOAD_METHOD = "wget")

# Check that the LAADS download method is set correctly (should return "wget")
Sys.getenv()[grep("LAADS", names(Sys.getenv()))]

# Optional: verify that wget is installed and accessible from the system PATH
# system("wget --version")
```

```{r}
# Folders
h5_folder <- file.path(getwd(), "blackmarble_h5")  # stable folder for HDF5 files
dir.create(h5_folder, showWarnings = FALSE)

output_dir <- file.path(getwd(), "bm_outputs")     # folder for final rasters
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# Vector of months to download

# Define start and end date
start_date <- ymd("2021-10-01")
end_date   <- ymd("2021-12-01")

# Generate a sequence of months
months <- seq.Date(from = start_date, to = end_date, by = "month") %>%
  format("%Y-%m")  # format as "YYYY-MM"

months
```

```{r}
# Loop over each month
for (m in months) {
  
  cat("Processing month:", m, "...\n")
  
  # Download raster for the month, HDF5 saved in h5_folder
  r_month <- bm_raster(
    roi_sf = roi_sf,
    product_id = "VNP46A3",
    date = m,
    bearer = bearer,
    download_method = "wget",
    h5_dir = h5_folder,   # <- HDF5 saved here
    quiet = FALSE
  )
  
  # Check if raster is valid
  if (!is.null(r_month) && nlyr(r_month) > 0) {
    
    # Generate filenames based on month
    month_str <- gsub("-", "_", m)
    tif_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("ntl_", month_str, ".tif"))
    rds_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("ntl_", month_str, ".Rds"))
    
    # Save raster to bm_outputs folder
    writeRaster(r_month, filename = tif_file, overwrite = TRUE)
    saveRDS(r_month, rds_file)
    
    cat("Saved raster for", m, "in bm_outputs\n")
    
  } else {
    cat("Download failed or raster empty for", m, "\n")
  }
}
```

## Map of Nighttime Lights

```{r}
# Read raster for a given month
file_rds <- file.path(getwd(), "bm_outputs", "ntl_2021_10.Rds")
r <- readRDS(file_rds)

#### Prep data
r <- r |> terra::mask(roi_sf)

## Distribution is skewed, so log
r[] <- log(r[] + 1)

# Extract month and year from filename
filename <- basename(file_rds)
parts <- strsplit(gsub("ntl_|\\.Rds", "", filename), "_")[[1]]  # "2021_12"
year_val <- parts[1]
month_val <- parts[2]

# Convert numeric month to month name
month_name <- month.name[as.numeric(month_val)]

##### Map
ggplot() +
  geom_spatraster(data = r) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "black",
                       mid = "yellow",
                       high = "red",
                       midpoint = 2.5,
                       na.value = "transparent") +
  labs(title = paste("Nighttime Lights:", month_name, year_val)) +
  coord_sf() +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
# List RDS files for each month
rds_files <- list.files(file.path(getwd(), "bm_outputs"), 
                        pattern = "ntl_.*\\.Rds$", full.names = TRUE)

# Generate a list of plots
plots <- map(rds_files, function(f) {
  
  #### Prep data for the month
  r_month <- readRDS(f) |> terra::mask(roi_sf)
  
  ## Distribution is skewed, so apply log
  r_month[] <- log(r_month[] + 1)
  
  ##### Map
  # Extract year and month from filename
  ym <- gsub("ntl_|\\.Rds", "", basename(f))  # e.g., "2021_10"
  ym_split <- strsplit(ym, "_")[[1]]
  year <- ym_split[1]
  month_name <- month.name[as.integer(ym_split[2])]  # Convert number to month name
  
  ggplot() +
    geom_spatraster(data = r_month) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "black",
                         mid = "yellow",
                         high = "red",
                         midpoint = 2.5,
                         na.value = "transparent") +
    labs(title = paste(month_name, year)) +
    coord_sf() +
    theme_void() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
          legend.position = "none")
})

# Display all maps together in a grid
gridExtra::grid.arrange(grobs = plots, ncol = 3)
```
